tests.title: A staff account with a limited role cannot see or open admin-only pages
tests.goal: Staff roles restrict what each staff member can do in the CRM.
preconditions: A second staff account with a limited role. Ask the user first: creating staff or changing staff mapping needs approval (README)
data: Admin-only URLs read at runtime from the .env staff account menus (settings, staff, promotions, reports)

steps.text: Log in as the limited staff account and note the menus

expected.text: Menus show only what the role allows
Direct URLs are refused or redirected; no data is shown and nothing can be saved
